rule: Use public references only as idea sources; do not import claimed PnL or tuned parameters as evidence.
First pass gets one simple representative candidate per family; no variant ladder.
Freeze rules, stops, exits, sizing, market scope, and data source before validation.
Same 19 markets where data permits; BTCUSDT/DOGE/DOT/UNI always reported.
Uniform fee/slippage assumptions and no leverage unless isolated research-only plan says otherwise.
Every candidate compared to no-trade, passive BTC, and simple buy-and-hold where feasible.
For every candidate, document signal timing, indicator warmup, entry candle handling, and data alignment.
Tournament can only promote to needs_confirmation_plan, never dry-run/live/implementation-ready.
ML family must use walk-forward training, fixed feature list, leakage checks, and naive baseline comparisons.
